issue_request: FHIR-31597 was a Published/Persuasive R5 BRR change request to add Ingredient.group as a 0..1 CodeableConcept for coded physical-location groupings such as tablet hull, inner body, or ink.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied by c31cf6846019e402344efec66a1782bc32968829, whose subject explicitly says it added Ingredient.group for FHIR#31597. Blame shows the current Ingredient.group element lines still come from that commit. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-31597 commit was found on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: Ingredient is an active current build resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/fhir.ini maps the ingredient folder to the Ingredient resource and BRR work group. BRR minutes for 2021-03-23 record discussion of the substance/ingredient distinction and a 19-0-2 motion to accept FHIR-31597 as proposed. Jira search for Ingredient.group found no later FHIR-core issue that changes this request, and Zulip direct key search found no directly relevant discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The active source already contains Ingredient.group with min 0, max 1, and CodeableConcept type, so an additional source edit would be redundant.
